textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: Guðmundr ok Asgautr ok Sæbiorn/Sigbiorn ok Gæiʀbiorn letu ræisa stæin æftiʀ Borggæiʀ, faður sinn. Hialpi Guð hans and.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: Guðmundr ok Ásgautr ok Sæbjǫrn/Sigbjǫrn ok Geirbjǫrn létu reisa stein eptir Borggeir, fǫður sinn. Hjalpi Guð hans ǫnd.
textLayer.translationSwedish: … lät göra denna häll efter sin fader… Gud hjälpe hans själ.
textLayer.translationEnglish: … had this slab made in memory of his father… May God help his soul.
